messages:
maya: heads up — onboarding titan-3b-q4f into the eval harness is failing the CI regression suite :eyes:
oli: which test?
maya: test_chat_consistency keeps timing out and BLEU/EM numbers are wildly off. pytest output:
```
E       AssertionError: EM 0.02 != expected > 0.6
E       TokenOverlap metric: got 34, expected ~70
```
sam: did the tokenizer mapping get added for titan? last model needed strip_leading_space flag
maya: i added a config under models/titan-3b-q4f.yaml but probably missed tokenizer options. current snippet:
```
model: titan-3b-q4f
tokenizer: open_bpe
chat_template: default_stream
quant: q4f
```
jess: infra logs show eval-runner resetting cache incorrectly for batched chat. there's a commit that changed inference.batch_reset to false for q4 variants
eval-runner-bot: detected mismatch: incoming token ids length != prompt token count (model=titan-3b-q4f)
oli: also noticed titan's tokenizer emits a leading byte 0x7e on system messages — we saw that with other BPE models too, needs strip_prefix or strip_leading_space
maya: ok two issues: tokenizer config missing strip_prefix, and runner batch_reset bug. sam can you wire a quick unit test for the cache reset? :+1:
sam: on it — will add test in tests/eval_runner/test_cache.py and include titan fixture. opening PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/PR/4278
sam: also adding a metric mapping patch — metrics_ingest expects "token_overlap" but harness emits "TokenOverlap" and dashboard drops it
jess: i can update ingestion to accept either and add metrics.yaml alias for titan-3b-q4f
dashboard-bot: metrics pipeline rebased; will need a small migration to map "TokenOverlap" -> "token_overlap" in historic rows
maya: sounds good. after fixes i'll run full regression and post numbers. if qa passes we can unflag titan from canary
oli: note: adjust chat_template to include leading_space: false to avoid extra token
maya: thanks team. i'll follow up with PR links and CI green ping
sam: PRs -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/PR/4279 (tokenizer config), https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/PR/4280 (runner cache fix)
jess: rolled metric alias change to staging, ingestion lambda redeployed
maya: CI is green on my branch, numbers back in range. leaving a quick note in docs: models/titan-3b-q4f.md about tokenizer quirks and recommended config
oli: :tada:
